headline: 8 ABC LICENSES.
EARLY REVIEW
FROZEN.
hook: A judge blocked the FCC's early review of all 8 ABC-owned station licenses.
The FCC says it's about DEI. It says the ruling is wrong.
hero_sub: Licenses were called in 2.6 to 5.3 years early, one day after Trump's post on Kimmel (FCC schedule; Variety)
